title: hedychium coronarium var. flavescens
intro: Hedychium coronarium var. flavescens, commonly known as White Ginger Lily, is a variant of the Hedychium coronarium plant, which belongs to the Zingiberaceae family. It is a tropical plant with medicinal properties, valued for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of White Ginger Lily include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which have been observed in various studies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerols, shogaols, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
